title: Pasta e Ceci
author: Claude
description: Roman chickpea and pasta stew, half soup, half pasta. Rosemary, garlic and a little tomato.
steps: Soften the onion in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, rosemary and tomato paste and fry for a minute.
Add the chickpeas and broth and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove the rosemary and blend about a third of the pot to thicken it.
Add the pasta and cook it in the stew, stirring often and adding water if it gets too thick.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with olive oil and parmesan.
